summary: Apartment lease with deposit, default and self-help violations.

findings.quote: Landlord may deposit the security deposit in its general operating account and may use those funds for property expenses during the Lease Term.

findings.note: Deposit taken, no disclosure anywhere in the lease.

findings.quote: within 30 days after Resident vacates if no claim is made
Landlord will notify Resident in writing within 45 days after Resident vacates
the 3 days are calendar days and include Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays
If rent is more than 10 days late, Landlord may change the locks to the Unit until all amounts owed are paid in full.
Landlord may shut off water service to the Unit if Resident's account is more than 15 days past due.

outOfScope.quote: A late fee of $100.00 applies to any rent received after the 3rd of the month.

nearMisses.quote: Resident will promptly report leaks and will pay for repairs to damage Resident or Resident's guests cause.
